# Close wrap, Tue Oct 20, 2026 (Research Inc., ~4:26 PM ET)

**Earnings and cheaper oil lift the Dow; AI keeps the Nasdaq flat.**

- **Indexes:** Dow +529.85 (+1.02%) to 52,495.88; S&P +0.28% to 7,712.57; Nasdaq −0.02% to 26,424.82. Health care (+2%+), real estate and utilities led; comm services, tech and energy lagged. 10y −4 bp to ~5.096%; Brent −1.2% to ~$108.23, WTI ~$102.74. ([CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/10/19/stock-market-today-live-updates.html), [AP](https://apnews.com/article/stock-markets-oil-ai-rates-inflation-b972b64127db5412a2b02c35ecf95c88), [Reuters via Euronext](https://live.euronext.com/en/financial-news/stocks-mostly-rise-oil-us-yields-ease-euro-edges))
- **Why:** Unconfirmed US-Iran deal report spiked then reversed; housing slump (starts −5.2%, pending sales record low) eased yields; Fed-hike odds for Oct 28 fell to ~15%. ([X news](https://x.com/i/trending/2112626920496247065), [Reuters via Euronext](https://live.euronext.com/en/financial-news/stocks-mostly-rise-oil-us-yields-ease-euro-edges))
- **Covered tickers:** MMM +5.86% ($171.50), HAL +1.90%, RTX +0.65% (faded from $197 high), GM −6.83%, BLK +0.35%, XLP +0.41%, AMZN +0.07%, DDOG −1.51%. ([MMM](https://exa.ai/library/markets/stock/MMM?date=2026-10-20&view=daily), [HAL](https://exa.ai/library/markets/stock/HAL?date=2026-10-20&view=daily&measure=change), [RTX](https://exa.ai/library/markets/stock/RTX?date=2026-10-20&view=daily), [GM](https://exa.ai/library/markets/stock/GM?date=2026-10-20&view=daily&measure=change), [BLK](https://exa.ai/library/markets/stock/BLK?date=2026-10-20&view=daily), [XLP](https://stockanalysis.com/etf/xlp/history/), [AMZN](https://finance.yahoo.com/quote/AMZN/history/), [DDOG](https://exa.ai/library/markets/stock/DDOG?date=2026-10-20&view=daily))
- **After hours:** SpaceX revenue $14.6B vs ~$12.7–13B est, first GAAP profit; lock-ups start Oct 22. NFLX EPS $0.87 vs $0.82, revenue $12.87B in line, Q4 guide $13.44B soft; shares down AH. ISRG Q3 revenue $3.05B (+22%); COF adj EPS $6.69. UAL reaction not yet confirmed. ([SpaceX](https://x.com/i/trending/2112637290938061012), [NFLX](https://x.com/i/trending/2112637290933789168), [StockTitan](https://www.stocktitan.net/news/2026-10-20/))
- **Tomorrow:** T, ABT, TMO, PM, NEE BMO; EIA crude 10:30; TSLA, META, IBM, LRCX, TXN AMC.

## Ideas (long-only, swing)
- **MMM**: Q3 adj EPS $2.50, FY guide raised, expanded Amazon data-center partnership; closed near the high. Conf: low-med. Risk: +6% earnings gap can fade (lesson 10/09); industrial demand sensitive to housing slump.
- **RTX** (hold, no re-add): beat-and-raise held green but faded intraday. Conf: med. Risk: rotation back into tech.

**Avoid changes:** add NFLX (soft Q4 guide, AH drop) and SPCX (lock-up supply from Oct 22). Keep airlines (UAL reaction pending, Brent ~$108), semis/memory, AI optics, AI-debt infra, GM, GPC, BAC.
